title: AI for Energy Efficiency and Thermal Comfort
place: Omnia Energia and Aeinnovation Energy (AEI Srl), Italy
description: Predictive models for indoor temperature and occupancy using indoor and outdoor sensor data from the AEI IoT lab. Pruning and quantization make them light enough for edge-cloud deployment, with a Digital Twin on top.

title: Soil Moisture Forecasting for Irish Agriculture
description: TinyTransformer (SoilFormer) for energy-efficient soil moisture forecasting from field sensors. Partially funded by the Irish Government and Met Éireann, using data from the ISMON network.

title: Digital Twin for Indoor Temperature and Occupancy
description: Deep learning models validated for accuracy and reliability in the ICAR-CNR IoT lab rooms. The Digital Twin paradigm supports real-time monitoring, simulation and prediction.

title: IoT Smart Home Management with TinyML
place: PhD research, University of Calabria, Italy
description: TinyML and deep learning on smart-environment sensor data to predict indoor temperature and occupancy while keeping residents comfortable. Next steps: activity recognition, privacy preservation and TinyLLM for HVAC control.

title: AI Healthcare with Deep Learning
description: Deep learning models for classification and prediction tasks in smart healthcare environments, with a focus on smart hospitals.

title: Credit Card Fraud Detection
description: Compared machine learning models on anonymized credit card transactions, with a focus on SMOTE and ADASYN synthetic data generation for imbalanced classes.
